name: Essential Free Shipping Bar
summary: Shopify free-shipping progress bar for the top bar, product pages and cart, with cart goals, upsell products, geo-targeting and product exclusions; the free-shipping rate itself is set in Shopify.
best_for: Shopify stores that already offer free shipping above a threshold and want a no-code progress bar on the top bar or product pages, and that will pay $14.99 once they want it in the cart with upsell products next to it
skip_if: you want the progress bar in the cart without paying, because cart-page boosters start at $14.99 a month; you expect the app to create the free-shipping offer itself, since the rate has to be set in Shopify for each market; or your cart drawer app already has a reward or shipping bar built in
honest_knock:
The cart page, where a free-shipping progress bar does most of its work, is not on the free plan and not on Starter either. Cart-page boosters start on Essential at $14.99 a month; Free and Starter cover the top bar and product pages. One merchant uninstalled within an hour over exactly that in February 2026, calling it the obvious place for the bar; the vendor replied that the limits are on the listing, which is true. Upsell products inside the bar and the revenue analytics the listing advertises are on the same $14.99 tier.

The app shows the goal; it does not give the free shipping. The help centre says the app does not touch your store settings, so you set the free-shipping rate yourself in Shopify's shipping settings, as a conditional rate based on order price, and you do it again for every market. If the threshold in the bar and the threshold in Shopify drift apart, the bar promises something checkout does not deliver. Currencies work the same way: a currency missing from the dropdown needs its own Shopify Market first.

Views are counted on every load of every widget, and the free plan's 1,000 a month is small for a bar that sits on every product page. The help centre says Preview mode and the theme customiser are not counted; one merchant wrote in March 2026 that editing product pages in the customiser used up views, so check the counter after a design session. Past the limit there is no charge, but three days after the warning email the banners are unpublished until the 1st.

Two older complaints are worth knowing. A merchant in Japan wrote that the bar did not update when a shopper switched variants and prices; the vendor answered that real-time variant updates are supported and offered to help. And a UK merchant wrote in 2023 that uninstalling left code behind in the theme. Check the theme after removal. We have not installed the app.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-29 on apps.shopify.com/essential-order-value-booster, on essential-apps.com/free-shipping-bar and in the vendor's help articles on views and on setup) Four plans priced on monthly booster views. Free covers up to 1,000 views a month with unlimited top-bar and product-page boosters. Starter is $9.99 a month for up to 10,000 views and adds geolocation targeting and excluding products from the goal. Essential is $14.99 a month for up to 50,000 views and adds cart-page boosters, upsell products inside the bar and analytics. Professional is $29.99 a month for unlimited views and every premium feature. Paid plans carry a 7-day free trial. The listing shows monthly prices only; the help centre says a yearly billing cycle can be chosen inside the app, and we found no published yearly price. A view is counted each time the widget loads, not per visitor; the help centre says Preview mode and the theme customiser are not counted. There is no overage charge: past the limit you get an email, and if you do not upgrade within 3 days the banners are unpublished until views reset on the 1st. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Essential Apps, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 3 June 2022 and shows 964 reviews.

free_plan_evidence: Free covers up to 1,000 views a month with unlimited top-bar and product-page boosters.

compare_with.name: Kite
compare_with.why: Kite is the closest app in our own dossiers with a progress bar, and the difference is what sits behind the bar. On our reading of 17 September 2026 Kite applied the reward itself - free gifts, buy X get Y and tiered discounts on native Shopify Functions - with progress bars from its $29 Starter plan and a free plan capped at 50 discount orders a month. Essential Free Shipping Bar only shows the goal: it starts free at 1,000 views and charges $9.99, $14.99 or $29.99 for more views, and the free shipping itself is a rate you set in Shopify. A store that wants one message - spend this much for free shipping - fits Essential at a fraction of the price; a store that wants the bar to unlock gifts and discounts it cannot configure in Shopify's shipping settings fits Kite.
